name: Product Research
description: Research a market before writing anything: compare competitors on features, pricing and positioning, profile the companies involved, assemble the findings into a data-backed report, and turn the result into a proposal.
description_zh: 先摸清市场再动笔：对比竞品的功能、定价和定位，了解相关公司背景，把结论整理成有数据支撑的报告，最后写成方案。
